correctness.rationale: The census, maps, orbits, and cyclic descendants are correct. A clean check embeds the descendant into the direct product by g↦(gB(g),B(g)); its closure follows from the identity, and projecting the second factor gives the kernel–image size rule. Values are constant on the sets Kg (right cosets in standard terminology, though the record calls them left): B(kg)=B(g) for k in the kernel. In the order-two kernel case, applying the identity to (r,s) excludes B(r)=r. In the bijective case theta(u)=B^{-1}(u)u is an endomorphism; every nontrivial endomorphism of S3 fixes a nonidentity element (an implementer of an inner automorphism, any nonidentity element for the identity automorphism, or the image transposition for order-two image), excluding bijectivity of u↦theta(u)u^{-1}. For a splitting map B(hl)=l^{-1}, the graph above is H×L; the involution swaps the coordinates, proving the stated pairing. Independently enumerated all 46,656 arrays of six outputs using lexicographic three-letter permutations and composition p[q[i]], filtering by the identity on all 36 pairs. This gives (6,1):1, (2,3):3, (3,2):3, (1,6):1; inner conjugation gives orbits in that order with sizes 1,3,3,1, involution reverses that ordering, and each proper split has orders 1,2,3,3,6,6. The frozen checker was inspected but not executed.
residual_risks: The terminology for Kg in the proof is reversed, not the actual factorization used.

evidence: Main theorem p. 2 gives four brace classes with additive C3⋊C2 when p=3,q=2. Lemmas 3.5, 3.7, 3.10 (pp. 6–7) give respectively p=3, p=3, and p(q−2)+1=1 regular subgroups of projection image sizes 3,2,6; trivial projection supplies the remaining unique subgroup. The size-two and size-three projections have cyclic regular subgroup. Theorem 3.6 and Proposition 3.8 identify the corresponding orbit counts.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The correspondence preserves projection image size, identifies the regular subgroup with the descendant group, and preserves the conjugation action. Thus it implies both the total eight and the entire orbit and kernel-image census, not just four abstract types.
